1. App language set to Simplified Chinese (`launch --lang zh-Hans-CN`)
2. After the row a plain `launch` restores the language
3. Any tier (Launcher › Pink › ☰ › [0] IAP), with at least 6 credits
4. Menu › Settings › 「Remove AIGC Watermark」 is Off
5. Neither 「Don’t show again」 ticked on this install: the MUI phase runs before TC-126 and TC-127
6. The project with AI Anime content of TC-083
Action:
1. Open Home › ☰ Menu
2. Scroll to 「Settings」 and read the 「Remove AIGC Watermark」 row (TC-001)
3. Tap the ⓘ beside the row and read the sheet (TC-004)
4. Tap 「Got it」 (TC-005)
5. Open AI Music Generator
6. Type a short description
7. Tap 「Generate for ◆ 6」 and read the dialog (TC-054)
8. Tap 「Cancel」 (TC-055: nothing is generated, no credits taken)
9. Open the project with AI Anime content
10. Tap 「Export」 and read the dialog (TC-083)
11. Tap 「Cancel」 (TC-084)
Expected Result:
1. Every string shows in Simplified Chinese (simplified characters) and says what the English says
2. No string is left in English, except 「AIGC」 (an acronym, may stay as is)
3. No string shows a key, a placeholder (%@, %s, {0}) or another language
4. The feature name and the terms (AIGC Watermark, Remove AIGC Watermark, Don’t show again) read the same on every screen; 「Menu > Settings」 in both dialog bodies uses the words the Menu and Settings screens show in that language
5. No translation sheet (REQ-011): a string that only seems off is a translation doubt in the run's mui-doubts.md, not a fail
6. Every string on every screen of the walk shows in full: none ends in 「…」, is cut at an edge or loses a line
7. No string overlaps another element or runs out of its row, sheet, checkbox, button or dialog
8. The Settings row keeps its ⓘ right after the text and its switch at the right edge, on the same line or wrapped, never pushed off the screen
9. The dialog buttons (「Cancel」 and 「Generate」 / 「Export」) keep their size and place, side by side or stacked as in English, and the checkbox label stays beside its box
10. Longest strings first: the info sheet body, the two dialog bodies, 「Remove AIGC Watermark」 in the Settings row
11. Settings row: 「Remove AIGC Watermark」 beside its ⓘ and switch
12. Info sheet: 「AIGC Watermark」, 「Depending on applicable laws and regulations, you may need to label or watermark AI-generated content before sharing it publicly. This feature is provided to help you meet those requirements.」, 「Got it」
13. Music dialog: 「AIGC Watermark」, 「Your generated music will include an AIGC watermark. To remove the watermark, go to Menu > Settings.」, 「Don’t show again」, 「Cancel」, 「Generate」
14. Export dialog: 「AIGC Watermark」, 「Your exported file will include an AIGC watermark. To remove the watermark, go to Menu > Settings.」, 「Don’t show again」, 「Cancel」, 「Export」
Notes: MUI CHS (zh-Hans-CN). One `texts` read and screenshot per screen; nothing generated or exported (both dialogs end in 「Cancel」).
